rv.q: It's a palpably intelligent one that proves Enron was not a flash in the pan and that Prebble is one of the long line of dramatists who view medical practice with a rational scepticism.
Another excellent Cottesloe production from the NT and Headlong. Definitely worth seeing for the emotional journeys, even if you have no interest in the topic of mental illness and neuroscience.

cn.t: Prebble's intimate four-hander about love and neuroscience earns praise for excellent performances, absorbing drama, and beautiful clinical design, with Goold's immaculate direction proving the playwright's range beyond her hit Enron.
